name: repo-radar
description: Local Git repo dashboard that scans all your repos — the entry screen is a cross-repo action queue answering "what needs you now".
author: rockbenben <qingwhat@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm test -w server && npm test -w web
